description: This Java source file defines the NoteEditor activity for an Android note-taking app. It handles creating, editing, viewing, and deleting notes, including clipboard paste functionality and custom UI components like a lined EditText.

classes.name: NoteEditor
classes.description: Main activity class for editing notes, handling user interactions, data loading, and clipboard operations.

classes.name: LinedEditText
classes.description: Custom EditText view that draws lines between text lines for improved readability.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, determines action (edit, insert, paste), sets up UI and data loader.

methods.name: onSaveInstanceState
methods.description: Saves the original content state for activity recreation.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Placeholder for pause handling; currently calls super.

methods.name: onStop
methods.description: Saves or deletes note based on activity state and content.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Creates options menu with save, delete, revert, and additional actions.

methods.name: onPrepareOptionsMenu
methods.description: Enables or disables revert menu item based on note changes.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu actions: save, delete, revert.

methods.name: performPaste
methods.description: Pastes note data from clipboard into the editor.

methods.name: updateNote
methods.description: Updates or inserts note data into content provider.

methods.name: cancelNote
methods.description: Reverts changes or deletes new notes.

methods.name: onCreateLoader
methods.description: Creates a loader to asynchronously load note data.

methods.name: onLoadFinished
methods.description: Populates UI with loaded note data.

methods.name: onLoaderReset
methods.description: Handles loader reset; no specific action.
